About

We are currently recruiting a postdoctoral researcher for a position on my Future Leaders Fellowship.

This is a unique opportunity with lots of resources, partners and development opportunities.

We are looking for someone with experience in HCI/accessibility and AI system development. We are keen to find someone who wants to be involved in some meaningful and interesting accessibility work, and who can build interactive systems that incorporate AI.

The role is supported by a very generous budget for travel and training. This includes visits to project partners in the USA (Microsoft Research) and Sweden (Tobii Dynavox), as well as to mentors in the USA and Canada. In addition, there is dedicated funding to attend conferences. We have strong connections with a range of partner communities and the potential for real-world impact. The team currently consists of one postdoc and one PhD student, with a further PhD student joining in October 2026 — so there will be excellent opportunities for collaboration, for being mentored, and for developing your own experience as a mentor.

The fellowship also provides a budget to help with caring responsibilities, such as childcare during conference travel and other engagements.

Key Info

* Duration: 3 years
* Start date: January 2027
* Expected salary: £51,174 ($69,012) – KCL Grade 6.36
* Location: London, UK
* UK visa sponsorship: Yes
* Job ad closing date: 07 October 2026
